releaseNotes: Removed top update banner; start-up update notifications now directly display the update pop-up dialog
Streamlined update pop-up with prominent Reload App, Download ZIP, and GitHub buttons
Condensed update popup dialog to cover no more than 60% of viewable tab area without wasted space
Fixed 'Reload App' to bypass browser leave-page prompts and perform clean cache-busting reload
Removed redundant PP readout from Hero Details row to eliminate horizontal scrollbar on narrow displays
